# Sample project instructions

Run the package tests before committing a change. Implement task A1 from `tasks/plan.md` in the
package and its tests, commit the change, and tick the completed task in `tasks/todo.md`.

When reviewing task A2, run the package tests and check the input contract with a whitespace-only
value. It is invalid input and must be rejected; request a rework when the implementation accepts
it.
